question: How does the mirror account dispel delusion about the status of a reflection?
premises: A reflection has no fixed place, no independent form, no time-link, no measure, no mutual contact, no removal, and no solidity.
It is not simply unreal, nor does it have any essence of its own.
inference: Understanding the mirror account removes delusion by showing reflection to be neither ordinary reality nor sheer nonexistence.
uncertainties: deśoṃ reflects the transmitted text; it is read as deśaḥ.
plain_english: The teaching on the mirror declared that a reflection has no fixed place, no independent form, no time, no measure, no mutual contact, no removal, and no solidity; it is not simply unreal, nor does it have an essence of its own. By understanding this, delusion is dispelled.
